simple.meaning: עֲגָלָה (ʻăgâlâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something revolving , i.e. a wheeled vehicle.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 45:19. The surrounding context includes family, family line, offering, commandment, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲגָלָה (H5699) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: עֲגָלָה (ʻăgâlâh) / H5699 is traced through Genesis 45:19, Genesis 45:21, Genesis 45:27, Genesis 46:5 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: something revolving , i.e. a wheeled vehicle
definitions.full: H5699. agalah עֲגָלָה noun feminine cart (from rolling of wheels; Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician (Punic) עגלת (?) Lzb 336 ; Aramaic עֲגַלְתָּא , ; Semitic loan-word in Egyptian ¹gar θ a Bondi 38 , ±agolt Erman Egypt, 491 ; compare also Wilkinson Anc.Egypt.(1878),i.223-241, especially 235, also 249 (illustrated vehicles drawn by cattle, compare 1Sam 6:7 ; Num 7:3 )); — absolute ׳ע 1Sam 6:7 +, suffix עֶגְלָתוֺ Isa 28:28 ; plural עֲגָלוֺת Gen 45:19 +; construct עֶגְלֹת Num 7:3 ; — cart , used for transporting persons and things Gen 45:19 , 21 , 27 ; 46:5 (E), 1Sam 6:7 (twice in verse); 6:8 , 10 , 11 , 14 (twice in verse), 2Sam 6:3 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 13:7 (twice in verse); Num 7:3 ( ׳ע צָב covered carts ), 7:3 ; 7:6 ; 7:7 ; 7:8 (P); in simile Amos 2:13 , ׳הַע עֲבוֺת Isa 5:18 cart-rope , ע ׳אוֺפַן 28:27 of ( threshing -) wagon (compare Dr Amos. p. 228 ), ע ׳גִּלְגַּל 28:28 id. ; — ׳ע = war-chariots only Psa 46:10 (Du transport-wagons ).
